description: This file defines a report for salary payments via ECS in the ERPNext system, including functions to generate report columns, filter conditions, and retrieve salary data based on filters.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main function to generate report columns and data based on filters.

methods.name: get_columns
methods.description: Constructs the report columns, including conditional columns for India region.

methods.name: get_conditions
methods.description: Builds SQL WHERE clause conditions based on provided filters.

methods.name: get_data
methods.description: Retrieves salary data and employee details, assembling the report data.
